subject: Praesidio RFI — evidence submission, retention, and red-team findings
messages:
From: Sara Idris <sara.idris@praesidio.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@praesidio.com
Date: 2027-05-22T09:13:00-07:00
Subject: RFI: Evidence & logs for misuse monitoring and alerting

Hi Laura —

Thanks for the quick intake on this RFI. As part of our security review for the upcoming pilot, the security and procurement teams are requesting the following artifacts to close our technical due diligence: 

- High-level monitoring matrix showing which signals are captured (fraud, prompt misuse, prompt injection patterns, mass generation).
- Example alert runbooks (what triggers an alert, who is notified, escalation steps).
- Retention policy for telemetry and content (logs, recordings, embeddings) with export/archival options.
- Red-team / adversarial testing summary (sanitized) showing detection coverage and known gaps.
- Evidence of log integrity and tamper-evidence (hashing, access logs).

Can you confirm whether you can provide redacted versions of the red-team results and a short packet that maps monitoring signals to alert thresholds? Our target for completion is 2027-05-28 to keep the procurement timeline.

Appreciate it — I can loop in Alex (security) if we need a short call.

Sara Idris
Senior Security Analyst, Praesidio Financial

Attachment: praesidio_rfi_questions_20270522.pdf (pdf stub)
From: laura.bennett@redwood.com <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sara Idris <sara.idris@praesidio.com>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-23T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFI: Evidence & logs for misuse monitoring and alerting

Sara —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide a sanitized evidence packet that matches your asks. High-level answers up front:

- Monitoring signals: we capture generation volume anomalies, prompt similarity clustering (for mass generation), classifier-based policy flags, and heuristic detections for injection patterns. Matrix attached.
- Alerting: alerts emitted at three severity tiers; low = automated ticket to triage queue, medium = on-call paging, high = paged to security + account owner. Runbook excerpt attached.
- Retention: default telemetry retention is 90 days for high-fidelity traces; aggregated metrics and token-level billing records retained 365 days. We support export to customer-managed S3 buckets for long-term archival. Details in retention_policy_2027.pdf.
- Red-team: we will provide a sanitized PDF summarizing red-team scenarios and detection coverage; customer IDs and sample prompts will be redacted.
- Integrity: upload hashes and immutable storage for evidence bundles; audit logs retained per our SOC2 policy.

I'm attaching: redwood_safety_matrix_v2.xlsx, alerting_runbook_excerpt.md, and a preliminary redteam_summary_sanitized.pdf. 

We will need to scrub customer-identifying tokens from the raw test logs before sharing. Marcus and Karthik are on point for that; Jonas will confirm whether the red-team artifacts require a separate NDAs or additional controls for sharing. If you need the artifacts in a different format (e.g., CSV or direct S3 upload), let me know your preference.

Proposed next step: we can schedule a 30-min call to walk Alex through the alert thresholds (we typically share threshold ranges and example rates rather than absolute counts). Are you available 2027-05-27 morning PT?

Best,

Laura Bennett
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_safety_matrix_v2.xlsx (xlsx), redteam_summary_sanitized.pdf (pdf), alerting_runbook_excerpt.md (md)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-24T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Praesidio RFI — evidence submission, retention, and red-team findings

Laura / team — quick internal note before we push the packet to the customer: 

- Red-team PDF: we must remove any raw customer prompts and replace with paraphrased examples. Also strip internal run IDs. I can run the sanitizer and produce checksums.
- Retention docs: update retention_policy_2027.pdf to include export instructions for encrypted S3 + example lifecycle policy.
- Alerting runbook: add a short table mapping signal -> metric -> recommended threshold (this helps security teams map to SIEM). Jonas, can you confirm if sharing the example thresholds requires an additional Data Processing Agreement clause for pilots?

I'll take ownership of sanitization and produce a short change log. Target to have final packet ready 2027-05-26 EOD.

Marcus
Product Security Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: sanitization_checklist.txt (txt stub)
From: laura.bennett@redwood.com <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sara Idris <sara.idris@praesidio.com>, Alex Carroll <alex.carroll@praesidio.com>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-26T08:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFI: Evidence & logs for misuse monitoring and alerting

Sara / Alex —

Per our internal checklist, attached is the sanitized packet and the doc list. Highlights below: 

- redteam_summary_sanitized.pdf: high-level scenarios, detection coverage, and lessons learned (all customer-specific prompts and IDs redacted).
- redwood_safety_matrix_v2.xlsx: signal matrix mapping to alert severity and responsible team.
- retention_policy_2027.pdf: retention defaults and export instructions for encrypted S3.
- alerting_runbook_excerpt.md: excerpt showing triage flows and escalation contacts.

Drive link for the folder (read-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C4d_SafetyEvidence

If you'd like, Marcus and Karthik can join a 30-min walkthrough to go through thresholds and example SIEM mappings. Let me know if 2027-05-27 09:00 PT works for a quick call.

Regards,

Laura Bennett
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments sent: redwood_safety_matrix_v2.xlsx, redteam_summary_sanitized.pdf, retention_policy_2027.pdf, alerting_runbook_excerpt.md
From: Alex Carroll <alex.carroll@praesidio.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Sara Idris <sara.idris@praesidio.com>, procurement@praesidio.com
Date: 2027-05-28T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Praesidio RFI — evidence submission, retention, and red-team findings

Laura —

Thanks for the packet, looks good at a glance. Two quick clarifications before we mark the RFI closed: 

1) For alert thresholds, can you share the expected event-rate ranges (eg. percentile windows) you use to trigger medium vs high? We don't need absolute counts tied to other customers — ranges are fine.

2) For retention export, does the export include token-level traces if the customer requests it, or only aggregated metrics? We want to understand whether we can get token-level traces into our SEC-approved archive if needed.

If useful, we can take the 30-min call tomorrow at 09:00 PT — happy to have Sara + procurement join.

Alex Carroll
Security Lead, Praesidio Financial

--
